root_cause: Existing hourly revenue-learning-project fetches a bounded but potentially large candidate set and serially performs an individual PostgREST upsert for EVERY candidate. Production Netlify scheduler calls at 14:01:18 and 14:02:44 UTC ended HTTP 499 after ~14.99 s, with function invocation confirmed. Supabase source logged several HTTP200 writes and live revenue_learning_evidence had 134 unique rows with 111 updates within 2h. Unbounded HTTP fan-out is a measurable contributor, but not proven to be the sole cause of 499.
prevention_rule: In the existing canonical hourly projector, send at most 50 unique stable tenant-scoped evidence rows per single atomic upsert; retry whole failed batches in later existing runs with a stable fingerprinted OPEN obligation containing every pending evidence ID. Never invent a success if the Edge acknowledgement is absent/mismatched, never drop or truncate candidates, retain original per-item compatibility and no alternate scheduler/sender.

security.tenant: server supplied per envelope; evidenceRow overrides tenant_id for every row
security.source_freshness: No generated zero or synthetic outcomes
